Question: How much does kindness cost?
Answer: Let me share some incidents: 1. Once, my friend asked me to give him some web series. So, I filled my pendrive with it, gave it to him, and said, "Return the pendrive after one week." After one week, he returned to his hometown and never came back. 2. Once, I showed my answer sheet to my friend sitting behind me in the accounts exam. In class, only two students have solved that tough question: me and him. Me: "Look, I told you that I'm doing it correctly." He: "What are you saying? I solved this question on my own." 3. Once, I gave my book to my one-year-junior friend. At the time of returning the book, Me: "Can I get my book back?" He: "Actually, my mother gave it to the garbage recycler with old newspapers." 4. Once, I got off at a station during a train journey to buy chips. The uncle sitting beside me said, "Can you bring a water bottle for me?" I said, "Okay." Unfortunately, at the time of returning back, I got late and could barely catch the train. Me: "Next time, I have to be careful before getting off at a station." He: "But who even told you to get off the train?" 5. Once, my friend forgot to bring his lunch, so I told him he could eat from my lunch. I had two parathas, so I gave him one. Within a minute, he ate his paratha and was asking from my share 🤧. Hence, I'm still on my way to figuring out the cost of kindness!! Siddharth Xyz

Name: Siddharth Xyz
Question: What has Quora taught you?
Answer: Never feel attached to someone! I will answer this question very honestly. In February, I wrote my first answer with an attached picture of me. After that, within 29 days, I wrote 29 answers. Following that, many girls started to DM me, and I began to enjoy those interactions. However, all those conversations lasted for 2–3 days, and a few of them even for a week. After the final end of each conversation, I started to feel a weight on my chest. I questioned myself, "Why is it happening?" The answer is: I started feeling attached to them. On Quora, there are people who develop a crush on some other users, start following them, upvote their every post, and even comment on it. But trust me, even if you get a message from that person, you will not be able to hold a conversation with them for more than a week and when you see the final message you will also feel the same weight on your chest. Quora has taught me only one life lesson: "NEVER FEEL ATTACHED TO SOMEONE." ( Image: Gallery) Siddharth Xyz
